prompt: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: SharpShot Studio built-in cinematic desktop and captured-video background master
Primary request: Create an entirely original premium abstract wallpaper titled "Obsidian Tide".
Scene/backdrop: A monumental landscape of smooth carved obsidian and deep charcoal basalt flowing like a slow ocean tide, with sparse translucent smoked-glass ridges and subtle mineral seams.
Style/medium: Photoreal high-end 3D material study, tactile sculptural surfaces, editorial product-film art direction, physically plausible rendering, sophisticated rather than flashy.

Composition/framing: Exact 16:9 landscape composition intended for a 3840x2160 master. Keep the central 55% calm, spacious, low-frequency, and free of focal objects so a 16:9 screen recording remains readable. Place most sculptural energy along the far left and right edges and lower third. No hard horizon through the center.
Lighting/mood: Near-black ambient field, restrained cyan and sea-glass green rim light grazing the forms, deep shadow detail without crushed blacks, quiet dramatic atmosphere.
Color palette: Obsidian black, graphite, smoked gray, tiny accents of muted cyan and deep teal.
Materials/textures: Satin basalt, polished volcanic glass, microscopic mineral grain, soft atmospheric depth, no plastic look.

Constraints: Completely original artwork; no logos, no UI, no text, no watermark, no recognizable brand wallpaper, no copied Apple or Tella composition; preserve generous center-safe negative space; crisp enough for 4K display.
Avoid: neon cyberpunk glow, loud gradients, busy center, symmetrical orb, fabric folds, lens flare, star fields, landscape photography, obvious generative artifacts.
